data.description:
## What
Create tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh defining expected behavior of the cleanup recipe detection helper.

## Why
TDD RED phase: the detection helper is the only independently testable new behavior in this story. Sprint SKILL.md changes are instruction-only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh exists and is executable
- Tests verify: (a) given a git diff with unsorted/duplicate Python imports → outputs normalize-imports (python) as applicable recipe; (b) given a git diff with no Python/TypeScript/Ruby files → outputs nothing (no cleanup recipes applicable); (c) given a git diff with only TypeScript import disorder → outputs normalize-imports (typescript); (d) --format=json flag outputs JSON array [{"name": "normalize-imports", "language": "python"}] for applicable recipes; (e) empty diff (no staged files) → outputs nothing (exit 0)
- Tests inject RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH env var to use a test fixture registry (not live registry)
- All tests FAIL before Task 2 is complete

## File Impact
- CREATE: tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh

## Testing Mode
RED — write failing tests first

## Dependencies
None
data.title: RED: Write failing tests for detect-cleanup-recipes.sh
